notes.title: Updated to ver. 1.31!
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in Ver. 1.30: Achievements could not be unlocked.

We apologize for the inconvenience of not being able to unlock achievements since the update.
We thank all players who provided feedback.

notes.title: Simplified Chinese version released! (Updated to ver. 1.30!)
notes.notes:
A Chinese (Simplified) translation mode has been added to “BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT”!
We were able to implement it thanks to the kindness of our translator, Mr. Amei! Our sincere thanks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141361/18a4652d13874c1fc96b85d0bda51f1795184b56.png[/img].

You can select “Chinese” on the language selection screen after starting the NEW GAME.

🌟Ver. 1.30 Other updates
Addition and correction of the wording and gimmicks related to solving the riddles in the game.
Fixed other minor typos and bugs.

notes.title: BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT　中国語（簡体字）ローカライズ決定！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141361/9e888cb392ead29e1152e0c778af146b9c366b13.jpg[/img]

We have received an offer from a translator to translate “BLUE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT” into Chinese (simplified Chinese), and we are ready to make it happen!
We are currently working on the translation in good faith. We will inform you of the release information as soon as it becomes available!

notes.title: Updated to ver. 1.20! (ver.1.20にアップデートされました！)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141361/610c2ddd857b375ca693f8e5171d5f88c40481cc.jpg[/img]

・ゲーム新規スタート時に、難易度・主人公の口調・会話内容について
【中辛(Ver.1.1代仕様) / 辛口(Ver.1.0代仕様)】から選べるようになりました！（日本語版のみ）
※上記の選択で変わる主な部分
　・すべての発言における口調、セリフの変化（一つ一つは微々たる変化です）
　・バックヤードのドア前〜暗闇での会話内容
　・ベンチでの会話内容
　・入力形式の謎解き内容（当初の内容に戻せます）
　・脱出後の会話内容（一番大きな内容変化）


You can now choose between [Medium-Spicy (Ver. 1.1) or Spicy (Ver. 1.0)] for the difficulty level, tone of voice of the main character, and content of conversations when you start the game!
 (Japanese version only)
　The main changes that will be made by the above selection are as follows.
　　The tone of all the statements (each one is a slight change).
　　The content of the conversation in front of the backyard door - in the dark.
　　The conversation at the bench.
　　The contents of the puzzle in the input format (you can return to the original contents).
　　The Conversation after escape.

notes.title: Updated to ver. 1.11! (ver.1.11にアップデートされました！)
notes.notes:
・実績解除の条件である"星"の出現タイミングを調整しました。
・マローとニトロの会話内容について、1.0版と1.10版の間でさらに調整を掛けました。（1.0版よりも言動が優しいのは変わっていません）
・その他軽微なバグを調整しました。

The timing of the appearance of “stars,” which is a condition for unlocking achievements, has been adjusted.
The conversation between Mallow and Nitro has been further adjusted between the 1.0 and 1.10 versions (the conversation is still gentler than in 1.0). (The behavior of Marrow and Nitro is still gentler than in the 1.0 version.)
Other minor bugs have been adjusted.

notes.title: Updated to ver. 1.10! (ver.1.10にアップデートされました！)
notes.notes:
・入力形式の謎解きの答えがわからないとの声が多くあったため、内容を修正しました。（ゲームをプレイしてくださった方に、出来るだけ最後までクリアしてほしいと思い、その判断をしました。）
・主人公の言動が少し優しくなりました！：）


・The game has been modified due to the fact that many people have said that the riddles in the input format are difficult to solve. (We made that decision because we wanted those who played the game to complete it to the end as much as possible.)
・The main character's words and actions are now expressed a little more gently!：）
